title: A component copy follows its look once that look is drawn, and a second question can be removed
goal: Two rough edges in components with two questions (say Variant and Size). A copy set to an answer pair nobody has drawn shows the nearest drawing, and keeps showing that stand-in even after you draw the exact pair, until you pick the answer again. And once a second question is added there is no way to take it away. Both leave a person's copies or component wrong with no way to tell why.
notes: Source: log of done task a-component-can-have-a-variant-and-a-size-at-onc ('left rough: no way to remove a second question; a copy on an undrawn combination keeps the nearest drawing after the exact one is drawn, until picked again') and audit queue/audits/2026-10-09-variant-and-size.json rough. Code: Sources/PhotonzCore/ComponentVariantProperty.swift setInstanceVariantAnswer ~400-428 resolves the nearest drawing only at pick time; store the wanted pair and re-resolve when the original's drawings change (on Done). Add: Sources/Photonz/ComponentPanel.swift ~1608-1612 addComponentVariantProperty; no remove exists. Tests first in core.
acceptance: Reproduced first: the steps below are run and the stand-in staying is written into this task's log
Make a component, add a second look and a Size question, drop a copy and pick an undrawn pair, then in Edit Original draw that pair and press Done: the copy now shows the new drawing with no click
A second question can be removed from the same place it was added, with one undo step, and copies fall back to the remaining question's answers
Walks cover both cases and run green at Next defaults
Audit written under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Reproduced in core first (Scripts/test.sh --filter ComponentVariantFollowTests, before the fix): a copy on Secondary picked Large shows the Primary · Large stand-in; after Secondary · Large is drawn and the copies synced it STILL shows the stand-in (instanceVersion stays Primary·Large, instanceAnswers still held). Same through Edit Original + Done (returnFromEditingSpace in one History.perform). Also found: a copy on a drawing that disappears on Done falls to the component's FIRST drawing, so removing Size on the page would send a Secondary · Large copy to Primary rather than Secondary. App walk repro follows once the harness can say which drawing a copy shows.

Reproduced in the app (probe built with the sync fix switched off): Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/variant-follows-and-goes-walk.json -> step 58 (expectShows): 'the walk says every picked copy shows Default · Large, but Badge shows Secondary · Large'. That is the copy set to Default + Large keeping its Secondary · Large stand-in after Default · Large was drawn on Edit Original and Done pressed.

Before building (adversarial): a Figma user expects a property to be removable from its row; the panel's knob rows already carry a minus, so the question row gets the same minus plus a right-click Remove. Removing a question leaves drawings that only differed by it as duplicates, so each set keeps one (its first answer, Default) and the rest go, in one undo step; copies land on the drawing giving their remaining answers. Copies live in the document while the removal happens on the Edit Original page, so Done (returnFromEditingSpace) re-points any copy whose drawing vanished to the page drawing matching its remaining answers; with no match it still falls to the first look and is reported, as before.

Built: core removeComponentVariantProperty + drawnCombination (ComponentVariantProperty.swift), sync settles a waiting copy onto the real drawing (ComponentInstances.swift), Done re-points copies (ComponentLibrary.swift copiesLanding); app minus/right-click on question rows past the first (ComponentPanel.swift), EditorState.removeComponentVariantProperty hands the pick to the drawing it folded into; harness step expectShows (PlaytestScript/PlaytestHarness, docs table). 9 new core tests + script test; Scripts/test.sh 12162 passed. Walk variant-follows-and-goes-walk green at Next defaults (no flags), presses the minus with real pointer events; variant-and-size-walk and instance-properties-variants-mock-walk green. tutorial-component-versions-walk failed once in a batch and passed alone on rerun (flake, not this change).

left rough (under the bar, no task): after removing a question the remaining drawings stay where they stood in the grid, a column on a page still sized for it; reopening Edit Original keeps them there. Add/remove question are not in the menu bar (neither was Add before). No mock covers removal.

A copy waiting on an undrawn Variant+Size pair now moves onto the real drawing as soon as it is drawn (sync + Done), and a second question can be removed from its row on Edit Original (minus or right-click Remove Size) in one undo step, copies falling back to their remaining answers. Reproduced first in core and in the app (walk failed on the old behaviour). 9 new core tests, Scripts/test.sh 12162 passed; variant-follows-and-goes-walk green at Next defaults with a pointer press on the minus. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-10-variant-follows-and-goes.json. Commit a18f5203.
